system_identity: TRM Swarm OS v18.307 Microkernel Engine
architecture_type: Structured Action Vector & Microkernel Decision Substrate

Structured_Action_Vectors.description: Pre-softmax hidden state extraction collapsed to C-struct ActionVector (agent_id, intent_id, confidence, k3_trit).

K3_Kleene_Ternary_Logic.description: Three-valued logic (+1 TRUE, 0 UNKNOWN, -1 FALSE) for deterministic rule evaluation.

Fast_3D_Spatial_Indexing.description: Octree spatial partitioning for 3D coordinate bounding-box filtering.

High_Concurrency_Dispatch.description: Rayon multi-threaded parallel agent dispatch loop in pure Rust.

Free_Form_Text_Generation.reason: Requires an auto-regressive decode head (lm_head + vocabulary softmax sampling), which introduces token decoding loops.

Creative_Writing.reason: Non-deterministic text generation is outside the design scope of the structured action vector engine.

Fluent_Conversational_Prose.reason: Conversational UI output is handled by external interface renderers, not internal microkernel voltage states.

General_Artificial_Intelligence.reason: The system is a high-performance domain-specific microkernel, rules engine, and action dispatcher—not a general intelligence.
